scope: Synthetic goal/frequency/inventory/time/recovery and persistence checks; not a device run or an efficacy trial.
reviewLimit: These are synthetic deterministic selection, equipment, schedule, recovery and persistence assertions. Passing establishes that returned plans honor the tested constraints; it does not mean every scenario has an eligible plan, establish exact exercise-form or media-rights verification, or validate individual physiological outcomes.

source.description: Tested canonical working-tree inputs; source manifest recorded during this run and unchanged when the successful result was captured. Repository HEAD is provenance, not a claim that pending changes were committed.
source.aggregateFormat: SHA256 of sorted compact JSON mapping relative paths to file SHA256 values.

reportWrites: The existing check writes only .sites-runtime/fitness-fit-current.json. No historical tracked report was overwritten.
